commands.command:
set -eu
KEY="$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 michal@192.168.0.23 'bash -s' <<'PI_SCRIPT'
set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
BACKUP=".dev/deploy/unified-ux-20261104-09be8c4"
echo "PI_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "PI_DIRTY=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
echo "BACKUP_INDEX=$(sha256sum "$BACKUP/index-before.html" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "CURRENT_INDEX=$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "STAGED_INDEX_EXISTS=$(test -e frontend/dist/index.html.next && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "NEW_MAP_BUNDLE_EXISTS=$(test -s frontend/dist/assets/public-map-DWDElC8J.js && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "BACKEND_PID=$(systemctl show photomap.service --property MainPID --value)"
echo "TUNNEL_PID=$(systemctl show cloudflared.service --property MainPID --value)"
echo "SERVICE_STATUS=$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)"
echo "TUNNEL_STATUS=$(systemctl is-active cloudflared.service)"
curl -sS --max-time 10 -o /tmp/photomap-ux-current-html.html -w 'LOCAL_HTML_STATUS=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/
sha256sum /tmp/photomap-ux-current-html.html
curl -sS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w 'LOCAL_NEW_BUNDLE_STATUS=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/assets/public-map-DWDElC8J.js
curl -sS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w 'LOCAL_HEALTH_STATUS=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
curl -sS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w 'LOCAL_MAP_API_STATUS=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/places/map
echo "CURRENT_INDEX_ASSETS"; grep -oE '/assets/[^"]+\.(js|css)' frontend/dist/index.html | head -n 8
echo "HTTP_INDEX_ASSETS"; grep -oE '/assets/[^"]+\.(js|css)' /tmp/photomap-ux-current-html.html | head -n 8
PI_SCRIPT
curl -sS --connect-timeout 8 --max-time 15 -o /tmp/photomap-ux-current-public.html -w 'PUBLIC_STATUS=%{http_code}\n' https://photomap.pl/
shasum -a 256 /tmp/photomap-ux-current-public.html
